Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ## Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC) 1. The bidder/OEM shall be registered in the State of Gujarat. Valid GST/Udyam/registration proof shall be submitted along with the bid. 2. The bidder shall submit a Non-Blacklisting Affidavit on ₹100 Non-Judicial Stamp Paper, duly notarized, d eclaring that the firm has not been blacklisted by any Government Department/PSU. 3. The bidder/OEM shall possess a valid ISO 9001:2015 Certificate and submit the same along with the tec hnical bid. 4. The bidder shall conduct a physical site survey of all proposed installation locations within the jurisdictio n of the concerned Taluka Panchayat before execution of the work. A duly signed site survey report, count ersigned by the Officer-in-Charge of the Taluka Panchayat Office, shall be submitted as documentary proof . 5. Each lighting pole shall be 6 metres in height, equipped with the specified LED lighting fixtures, complet e with all necessary accessories, wiring, fittings, and mounting arrangements, as per the buyer's requirem ents and technical specifications. 6. The bidder shall be responsible for the transportation, loading, unloading, and delivery of all materials to the designated installation sites. All expenses related to transportation, installation, pole foundation, electr icity, sand, cement, water, tools, machinery, labour, and other consumables shall be borne by the bidder. 7. The successful bidder shall be responsible for the complete supply, installation, testing, and commission ing of the 6-metre lighting poles and associated lights at locations approved by the Taluka Panchayat, in a ccordance with the prescribed technical specifications and applicable standards.

8. The bidder/OEM shall have a functional service centre within the jurisdiction of the concerned Taluka Pa nchayat. Documentary proof, including the address and contact details, shall be submitted along with the bid. All technical complaints reported during the warranty period shall be resolved within 24 hours of comp laint registration. 9. The purchaser reserves the right to inspect the supplied materials and installation work and reject any materials or workmanship found to be non-compliant with the prescribed technical specifications or applic able contract terms. .
